review_status: DRAFT. All agronomy text has NOT been reviewed by an agronomist. Kiswahili text is machine-drafted and needs native speaker review.

first.sw: Ukaguzi wa kwanza wa kitalu hiki.

none.en: No trend: the result is not sure.

too_few_good_photos.en: Fewer than two photos were clear enough.
too_few_good_photos.sw: Picha zilizo wazi ni chini ya mbili.

low_confidence.en: The tool is not confident about these leaves.
low_confidence.sw: Kifaa hakina uhakika kuhusu majani haya.

leaves_disagree.en: The three leaves gave different answers.

rust.low.en: Check ten more trees in this block and count how many have orange powder under the leaves.
rust.low.sw: Kagua miti kumi zaidi katika kitalu hiki na uhesabu mingapi ina unga wa rangi ya machungwa chini ya majani.

rust.high.en: Tell the cooperative this week and ask for the extension officer. Keep the three leaves to show them.
rust.high.sw: Ambia chama cha ushirika wiki hii na uombe afisa ugani aje. Weka majani matatu uwaonyeshe.

miner.low.en: Check ten more trees in this block and count leaves with brown blotches.
miner.low.sw: Kagua miti kumi zaidi katika kitalu hiki na uhesabu majani yenye mabaka ya kahawia.

miner.high.en: Tell the cooperative this week and ask for the extension officer.
miner.high.sw: Ambia chama cha ushirika wiki hii na uombe afisa ugani aje.

phoma.low.en: Look at the windy or cold side of the block. Note whether young tips are dying back.
phoma.low.sw: Angalia upande wa kitalu wenye upepo au baridi. Andika kama vichipukizi vichanga vinakauka.

phoma.high.en: Tell the cooperative this week and ask for the extension officer.
phoma.high.sw: Ambia chama cha ushirika wiki hii na uombe afisa ugani aje.

cercospora.low.en: Check whether these trees get full sun with little shade or mulch. Note it for the officer.
cercospora.low.sw: Angalia kama miti hii inapata jua kali bila kivuli wala matandazo. Mwandikie afisa.

cercospora.high.en: Tell the cooperative this week and ask for the extension officer.
cercospora.high.sw: Ambia chama cha ushirika wiki hii na uombe afisa ugani aje.

healthy.low.en: No disease sign on these three leaves. Check again next week with leaves from the weakest trees.
healthy.low.sw: Hakuna dalili ya ugonjwa kwenye majani haya matatu. Kagua tena wiki ijayo kwa majani ya miti dhaifu zaidi.

not_sure.low.en: Take three new leaves in good light and try again. If it still says not sure, show the leaves to the cooperative.
not_sure.low.sw: Chukua majani matatu mapya kwenye mwanga mzuri ujaribu tena. Ikiendelea kusema sina uhakika, onyesha majani chama cha ushirika.

rust.en: Do not spray anything before a trained person has seen it.
rust.sw: Usinyunyizie chochote kabla mtu aliyefunzwa hajaona.

miner.en: Do not spray on your own. Spraying can kill the small wasps that naturally control leaf miner.
miner.sw: Usinyunyizie peke yako. Kunyunyizia kunaweza kuua nyigu wadogo wanaodhibiti mchimbaji wa majani kwa asili.

phoma.en: Do not spray anything before a trained person has seen it.
phoma.sw: Usinyunyizie chochote kabla mtu aliyefunzwa hajaona.

cercospora.en: Do not spray anything before a trained person has seen it.
cercospora.sw: Usinyunyizie chochote kabla mtu aliyefunzwa hajaona.

healthy.en: Do not treat for disease based on this check.
healthy.sw: Usitibu ugonjwa kwa sababu ya ukaguzi huu.

confirm.en: Show the leaves to the extension officer.

evidence.en: Recent weather has been warm and wet, which may favour it.
evidence.sw: Hali ya hewa ya hivi karibuni imekuwa ya joto na unyevu, ambayo huenda inasaidia ugonjwa huu.

evidence.en: Rain in the last 3 months was well below normal for this area. This may have reduced the crop.
evidence.sw: Mvua ya miezi 3 iliyopita ilikuwa chini sana ya kawaida kwa eneo hili. Huenda imepunguza mavuno.

confirm.en: Check soil moisture and whether flowering was poor.
confirm.sw: Kagua unyevu wa udongo na kama maua yalikuwa machache.

evidence.en: Soil in this area may be too acidic for coffee.
evidence.sw: Udongo wa eneo hili huenda una asidi nyingi mno kwa kahawa.

confirm.en: Ask the cooperative about a soil test.
confirm.sw: Uliza chama cha ushirika kuhusu kupima udongo.

evidence.en: This block was sprayed recently but signs may still be present.
evidence.sw: Kitalu hiki kilinyunyiziwa hivi karibuni lakini huenda dalili bado zipo.

confirm.en: Tell the officer what was sprayed and when.

evidence.en: This tool cannot see nutrient problems, root problems, or old trees.
evidence.sw: Kifaa hiki hakiwezi kuona matatizo ya virutubisho, mizizi, au miti mizee.

confirm.en: Ask a person if none of the above fits.
confirm.sw: Uliza mtu kama hakuna kati ya haya kinachofaa.

context_only.en: Context only, not from the leaves.
context_only.sw: Taarifa ya mazingira tu, si kutoka kwa majani.

context_unavailable.en: Weather and soil context is not available or is out of date.
context_unavailable.sw: Taarifa ya hali ya hewa na udongo haipo au imepitwa na wakati.

draft.en: Draft guidance, confirm with your extension officer.
draft.sw: Ushauri wa awali, thibitisha na afisa ugani wako.

footer.en: This tool helps you decide what to check. It does not replace the extension officer.
footer.sw: Kifaa hiki kinakusaidia kuamua nini cha kukagua. Hakichukui nafasi ya afisa ugani.

template_confident.en: JIRANI {date} Block {block}: {stress}, {severity}, {trend}. Do: {action}. Dont: {donot}. Not sure? Ask a person.
template_confident.sw: JIRANI {date} Kitalu {block}: {stress}, {severity}, {trend}. Fanya: {action}. Usi: {donot}. Shaka? Uliza mtu.

template_not_sure.en: JIRANI {date} Block {block}: NOT SURE. Do: {action}. Dont: {donot}. Ask a person.
template_not_sure.sw: JIRANI {date} Kitalu {block}: SINA UHAKIKA. Fanya: {action}. Usi: {donot}. Uliza mtu.
